build_aws_s3_cmd: build a python module that constructs AWS S3 CLI command arguments with a SAML profile
test_fs3_exists: test the python function that checks if a given path exists on S3 using aws s3 ls
run_get_html_wrappers: run the python script to download existing HTML wrapper files from S3 into local output directories
create_write_html_wrappers: create HTML download wrapper files for each wheel file found in the local output directory
run_to_aws: run the python script to upload all files from local output directories to the S3 destination bucket
